claims.text: Every line of code that ships is a capability, and some capabilities are used by somebody else, for something else, years later.
claims.quote: Every line of code that ships is a capability.

claims.text: Code has the shape of the Agent Behaviour Policy's grant and mandate: a library that parses a hundred formats in an application that reads one has a grant of a hundred and a mandate of one.
claims.quote: A library that can parse a hundred formats, in an application that reads one, has a grant of a hundred and a mandate of one.

claims.text: Apache's fix for Log4Shell was the feature's removal: version 2.16.0 completely removed support for message lookups.
claims.quote: Completely remove support for Message Lookups

claims.text: ImageTragick, Heartbleed and Text4Shell were each fixed by disabling or compiling out a feature most users never needed.
claims.quote: the published mitigation was to "use a policy file to disable the vulnerable ImageMagick coders."

claims.text: Of curl's 239 published vulnerabilities, 49 were in protocols other than HTTP, including both rated critical, and every one of those can be compiled out.
claims.quote: Of its 239, we counted 49, about one in five, in protocols other than HTTP

claims.text: Removing code never caught on for two reasons: it needed a map of what each piece is for and tests to prove nothing broke, and vendors were paid for features, not for less.
claims.quote: I have argued for removing code for years, and it never caught on, for two reasons.

claims.text: Pendo's 2019 analysis found that 80 percent of features in the average software product are rarely or never used, and 12% of features generate 80% of daily usage.
claims.quote: 80 percent of features in the average software product are rarely or never used

value.unit: percent of features rarely or never used

claims.text: Pendo estimated that publicly traded cloud software companies had spent up to $29.5 billion building rarely used features.
claims.quote: spent up to $29.5 billion building those rarely used features

claims.text: Tidelift's 2024 survey found about 60% of open source maintainers unpaid.
claims.quote: Tidelift's 2024 survey found about 60% of maintainers unpaid

claims.text: Models make the scaffolding cheap, the harness, fixtures and checks, and when that is cheap removing code is safe because you can prove what still works.
claims.quote: When that is cheap, removing code is safe, because you can prove what still works.

claims.text: Of 1,500 files in sgit and its dependencies, 428 ran for one real use case, pushing a vault from CI, and a tree holding only those passed it.
claims.quote: Of 1,500 files in the tool and its dependencies, 428 were kept, and the use case passed.

claims.text: The measurement showed its limits: a compiled binary held three quarters of the bytes and no coverage tool could see inside it.
claims.quote: a compiled binary held three quarters of the bytes, and no coverage tool could see inside it

claims.text: Azad, Laperdrix and Nikiforakis debloated four PHP applications to the features real users exercised: 46% smaller, half the complexity, up to 60% of known CVEs removed.
claims.quote: The applications were 46% smaller with half their original cyclomatic complexity, and up to 60% of known CVEs were removed in the best case

claims.text: In the Maven ecosystem 75.1% of analysed dependency relationships are bloated, and in PyPI more than half of dependencies are.
claims.quote: 75.1% of the analyzed dependency relationships are bloated.

value.unit: percent of Maven dependency relationships bloated

claims.text: Across about three million Maven packages, less than 1% have a reachable call path to vulnerable code in their dependencies.
claims.quote: less than 1% of packages have a reachable call path to vulnerable code in their dependencies.

value.unit: percent of packages with a reachable path to vulnerable code

claims.text: Brown and Pande showed that blindly cutting a binary can create new exploitable gadgets, so removing features at the source, from the use case down, is the stronger form.
claims.quote: blindly cutting a binary can create new exploitable gadgets while removing old ones

claims.text: The direction of travel is the minimal viable code path, and it applies at every level: company, product, feature and code.
claims.quote: So I think the direction of travel is clear, and it applies at every level.

claims.text: A minimal viable code path is the smallest amount of code that does exactly the job.
claims.quote: the smallest amount of code that does exactly the job

claims.text: The way to make the shipping organisation's accountability real is to make the thing small enough to check, by people, by agents and where possible by proof.
claims.quote: make the thing small enough to check, by people, by agents, and where possible by proof

claims.text: Every behaviour, decision and workflow policy runs some code whose own grant is usually far larger than the policy above it; the minimal code path is how the boundary reaches down.
claims.quote: That code has its own grant, and it is usually far larger than the policy above it.

claims.text: The specialists who know a component best maintain a minimal version of it for the people who use it, and get paid for that rather than for new features.
claims.quote: maintain a minimal version of it for the people who use it, and get paid for that, not for new features

claims.text: In the fractal market each piece ships with its own behaviour, decision and workflow policies and its Wardley stage, explorer, villager or town planner, so a buyer can choose by risk.
claims.quote: Each piece ships with its own behaviour policy, what the code can reach; its own decision policy, where it decides; and its own workflow policy, the flows it runs.

claims.text: Jerry Gamblin counted 48,185 published CVEs for 2025, up 20.6% on 2024, and 72,812 for 2026 by the end of September.
claims.quote: 48,185 for 2025, up 20.6% on 2024, and 72,812 for 2026 by the end of September alone

claims.text: Anthropic reported in February that its models had found and validated more than 500 high-severity vulnerabilities.
claims.quote: found and validated more than 500 high-severity vulnerabilities.

claims.text: curl, which had never had more than 24 CVEs in a year, has 69 in 2026 so far, 35 of them from one AI-assisted audit.
claims.quote: has 69 in 2026 so far, 35 of them from one AI-assisted audit, most of them low severity

claims.text: Google's Android team found memory-safety issues fell from 76% of Android vulnerabilities in 2019 to 24% in 2024, because the problem is overwhelmingly with new code.
claims.quote: memory-safety issues fell from 76% of Android vulnerabilities in 2019 to 24% in 2024

value.unit: percent of Android vulnerabilities that were memory-safety issues

claims.text: None of this will happen because it is more secure; minimal code has to win on what people feel: faster, lighter, simpler software.
claims.quote: None of this will happen because it is more secure.

claims.text: It is the lesson of sgit: nobody will choose it for its encryption, but encryption as a constraint pushed it towards better features and simpler workflows.
claims.quote: nobody will choose sgit for its encryption; if it succeeds, it will be because encryption, as a constraint, pushed it towards better features and simpler workflows

claims.text: The measurement is one tool and one use case; it shows the method works, not how much any other codebase would shrink.
claims.quote: The measurement is one tool and one use case.

claims.text: Removing code can remove things people need, which is why the map and the tests come first.
claims.quote: Removing code can remove things people need.

claims.text: The market is a proposal: maintainers paid for minimal versions exist in places, a fractal market of them does not yet.
claims.quote: The market is a proposal.

claims.text: Some figures are vendors' own or vary by method: Pendo's and Endor Labs' come from their own data, CVE totals differ by tracker, and the Standish figure is not relied on.
claims.quote: Some figures are vendors' or vary by method.
